# cycle_load_balancer (Data Source)

Reads the current load balancer service configuration for a Cycle environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_load_balancer" "api" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
}

output "lb_container_id" {
  value = data.cycle_load_balancer.api.container_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment whose load balancer should be read.

### Read-Only

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer service container is set to auto-update.
- `config` (String) The current load balancer configuration as a normalized JSON object.
- `container_id` (String) The ID of the load balancer service container, if one has been provisioned.
- `current_type` (String) The load balancer implementation currently in use (`haproxy` or `v1`).
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer service is currently enabled.
- `high_availability` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer service runs in high availability mode.
- `id` (String) The environment ID this load balancer belongs to.
